name: Eden AI Resume Parser
tagline: Multi-provider OCR resume parser via one unified Eden AI endpoint
description: Eden AI’s OCR Resume Parser exposes a single API that routes resume files to multiple underlying OCR/HR providers and returns structured candidate data (contact info, skills, education, experience). Developers send a file or URL with provider choices and receive normalized JSON, useful for ATS ingestion, candidate screening, and HR automation without integrating each vendor separately.

auth.details: Bearer token via Authorization header (Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY); API key from Eden AI dashboard after self-serve signup

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free credits on signup (amount varies; check dashboard); pay-as-you-go after credits
pricing.paid_plans: Pay-as-you-go and subscription plans via Eden AI pricing page

use_cases: parse uploaded PDF resume into structured candidate fields
extract skills education and work history from a resume URL
compare multi-provider resume parse quality in one request
ingest resumes into an ATS or recruiting pipeline
normalize resume contact info for candidate screening
